title: Grass for a Penny: Calgary's Ranch Era (Calgary Origins Ep 2)
script: Documentary about the ranch era around Calgary 1874-1912: prairie grass, foothills and Rocky Mountains, buffalo disappearing, cattle drives from Montana, blizzards and hard winters, ranch houses, branding irons, a railway reaching Calgary, Pat Burns' slaughterhouse on the Elbow River, a brewery, a frontier fort, maps of southern Alberta, timelines, the first Stampede in 1912, downtown Calgary today with the 3D city and night skyline.
